detail.longDescription:
Chatbots answer questions.

AI agents can potentially complete the task.

That difference could reshape how we use the internet.

An AI agent can:

• Understand a goal
• Plan several steps
• Search for information

Think:

Chatbot → “Here are the best hotels.”

AI agent → “I compared the hotels, checked your dates and budget, reviewed cancellation policies and prepared the best three options.”.
